summary: Nvidia reported 129% year-over-year earnings growth this week, delivering the AI-trade validation markets needed, while easing bond yields provided an additional lift, with the 10-year Treasury pulling back to 4.57% from 4.67%.
tweet: Nvidia's blowout quarter and a pullback in Treasury yields from multi-year highs are the week's twin drivers — lifting tech while bonds and gold stay under pressure from sticky inflation fears.
